name: Mars Hill
overview: Mars Hill, also known as the Areopagus, was the highest court in Athens where Paul addressed the Athenians about their religious practices. Observing their many devotions, including an altar to the 'Unknown God,' Paul used this as a starting point to proclaim the true God who made the world and does not dwell in man-made temples. His message highlights the ignorance in their worship and calls them to recognize the living Creator, emphasizing the contrast between their superstitions and the sovereign Lord of heaven and earth.
